item.title: Snapstudio 1.5
item.description: Fixes the guide's left-hand menu, which kept highlighting the first topic you clicked instead of the one you're reading.

item.title: Snapstudio 1.4
item.description: Adds a Snapstudio Guide. Open it from Help > Snapstudio Guide (⌘?) or Guide… in the menu bar menu. It covers recording, editing, zooms, sound, captions, exporting, screenshots, annotating, GIFs and keyboard shortcuts, with labeled pictures of the recording bar and the editor.

item.title: Snapstudio 1.3
item.description: A redesigned editor with a tool rail, named lanes, and light and dark colors that follow macOS. Recording: pause and resume, recordings that survive a crash, a face camera with layouts that change during the video, 24-bit lossless audio, background noise removal, a live microphone meter, and areas locked to a shape. Editing: captions and transcript editing, on-screen key presses, blur and image overlays, motion blur on zooms, sharper zoomed-in text with on-device AI sharpening, and sound polish with a voice compressor, limiter, noise gate, loudness matching and gain up to +40 dB. Exporting: runs in the background with presets and a file size limit, HEVC exports 1.5x faster, and colors are truer with less banding. Also a project library, screenshot extras and many fixes.

item.title: Snapstudio 1.2
item.description: A resizable timeline, text and callouts you can move and resize right on the preview, corner roundness for boxes, each callout kind remembering its last look, and a folder chooser in the export window.

item.title: Snapstudio 1.1
item.description: New editing tools: a waveform on the timeline, clip speed, freeze frames, text and callouts, fades, chapters, click sounds, silence cutting, Zoom on Speech, snapping and reordering, and per-zoom zoom in and out. GIF export can play forward then backward.

item.title: Snapstudio 1.0
item.description: First release: screenshots with annotation, scrolling capture, GIF recording with smooth cursor, and screen recording with an editor for zooms, cursor and backgrounds.
